items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: we formed a little small band with Mealy Bones, Bob Antony trumpet, Salmon, you know, his brother was there.

ctx.x: yeah well I never made a trip with him I just played you know local engagements on the capitol such as the present but I never made a regular river trip with him all the way up the same port and I just played locally on special occasions only and I worked with that outfit and from Sidney's band when we drift around and playing stuff

different bands around the city here. And when they went into the Depression days, come in, and we were just playing, we formed a little small band with Mealy Bones, Bob Antony trumpet, Salmon, you know, his brother was there.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Then they had two other older brothers too, they was banjo, like, I know you heard of Simon, John Morrell, well that was the older brother.

ctx.x: Yeah, cause Paul's related to you, isn't he?

Yeah, all of them, yeah. Paul, Aidan Lawrence. Then they had two other older brothers too, they was banjo, like, I know you heard of Simon, John Morrell, well that was the older brother. It was four brothers, two played bass, two played banjo.
Uh huh, Billy, that was, who was that your uncle?
